estimand: fixed-coordinate time-averaged normalized density on the original 560 nodes within [-14,14] lambda1
selection: all runs and all windows retained; no favorable-seed selection or early stopping on results
analysis: report per-run means, cross-code and C/E mean differences, front locations, paired half-profile changes within runs, and between-run spread; no qualified confidence band from three seeds
decision: estimate cost and spread for a prospective independent larger campaign; this pilot cannot pass stationarity, convergence or physical acceptance
reuse: historical outputs remain separate; pilot data used for design will not be relabeled as fresh confirmation
execution: two concurrent variant runners, full load, each with three seeds and both solvers; 8192 MB per-process limit; no time budget per user authorization
failure_policy: retain unfinished output; no automatic rerun of failed solver cases
